set.body: Active direction: docs/VISION.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md, with the 2026-09-18 owner decisions in docs/plans/EYESIM_BASELINE_PLAN.md. Complete the pinned eyesim baseline, usable public workflows, typed persistence, independent extensions and headless application consumption, then accept/stabilize the foundation. Study/recording/temporal execution, manifests and the UI-G1 isolated consumer are integrated on local main; M5 is closed with packaged JVM/JS evidence. Remaining foundation acceptance is tracked by bd-01M214CXGNS6HJQG8AM4EQXXF8 and its live dependencies: baseline gaps reported by tools/r-parity/check_baseline.py, documentation completeness, recording responsiveness and supported-runtime/release evidence. R is an offline parity oracle only; replace the old R-dependent template workflow with native shared QR. Deferred scientific/platform breadth retains its own phase epics and is not silently promoted into the foundation gate. No GUI, frame4s adapter or licensed EDF gate for pure development. Keep this roadmap open; update progress from linked acceptance gates rather than copied counts or stale branch status.
